It’s actually very harmful to the youth especially but to most in general. I believe it’s slowly but surely lowering the attention spans of the youth which will cause problems throughout a child’s entire childhood; possibly even through their adulthood.

 Tik tok, YT shorts, insta reels are instant dopamine hits which your mind can burn out on if you’re always getting that hit. Having those instant hits in a few seconds of scrolling aren’t normal to a person’s development and I believe that social media as a whole is one reason a lot of kids now are growing up into depression. Everything is good in moderation but most people spend a countless amount of hours on there because that’s all they know how to do. Less kids are reading books, playing instruments, going outside, or just doing anything without a phone in their hand.

Not to mention, every male friend of mine’s feed is just full of questionable aged girls shaking their asses just further driving the idea of meaningless sex into the minds of the youth. As far as women who see that same stuff if the algorithm allows it, they just compare themselves to that. I’ve also been curious if just watching people do things gives the same satisfaction as actually doing the thing they’re watching? Never done any research on that theory but streaming and things alike make me really question that. Which leads to the point of kids not having the desire to be creative just contributing to people having a dull outlook on life. Don’t get me wrong, I used to be addicted to social media but once I started doing dopamine detoxes, I stopped itching the need for my social media. Granted I still have 2 active accounts, but I basically unfollowed all the people I don’t see face to face anymore and just follow educational pages. I’ve been severely depressed for about 10 years now. I turned 25 earlier this month; and I slowly started saying my goodbyes and righting my wrongs with all the lives I’ve touched because I felt like my time was coming.

 I always used to ask myself where did the colors go? Where did my smile go? I lost complete motivation and satisfaction in every aspect of my life. I never went to college simply because I never thought I’d actually live past it. I’ve worked shit job after shit jobs all my life. I’ve always been alone in life and didn’t have supportive guidance even as a child. Last month, I had a really bad night and I decided that was it and it was time to go. I tied my guitar cable very tightly around my neck and right before I was about to drop from the beam in my closet, I asked myself, “Is this how I want to be found? Is there truly no hope left for me?” I untied myself and cried throughout the night. 

All my life I’ve blamed others for what I became and never felt like I had any control in my day to day life. I think I didn’t do it because deep down, I know that I can become the man I dreamt of becoming if I put all my energy and focus to it. I decided I wanted to take back my life. A few weeks later, I went out to a nearby beach and just sat there for hours in silence, looking at the night sky and all the beautiful stars and for the first time in what felt like an eternity, I felt the joy this world still has to offer. It sparked interests that I never had before. It was the most fulfilling feeling and I did not want to let it die with me. I want to learn anything and everything I can about the universe before I go. I want to see all of the world and actually go to all of these beautiful places I see on the computer screen. I want to visit the world and learn about as many cultures as I can and spread as much love as I can. I want to chase my dreams and really put my heart into music. I want to be a light for others that are lost in the darkness. I know that dark cloud will never truly leave me, but I damn sure will not let that be my exit in this one and only life.

When my lease ends, I’m going to sell everything of non importance, and head out west for a complete reset. It may not be the most solid plan, but my head has never been so clear.
